concept: UL-certifiable 800VDC rack-inlet protection module: solid-state disconnect + hot-swap precharge + ground-fault/arc-fault detection for AI racks
named_buyer_examples: Google/Meta/Microsoft via OCP Mount Diablo ecosystem
painful_job: 800VDC rack inlets have unresolved grounding, hot-plug, inrush, and oscillation behavior; DC arc-fault detection is not commodity even at LV; hyperscalers are deploying 800V racks faster than any listed protection product category exists.
product: A rack-inlet 800VDC solid-state protection module (SiC bidirectional switch + active precharge + microsecond fault interruption + DC arc/ground-fault analytics), sold as an OCP-compatible shelf to rack power OEMs, designed against IEC 62477-1 and emerging OCP specs.
frontier_vision: Become the default protection layer of the DC datacenter: from rack inlet to row-level 1500VDC and MVDC campus feeders, owning fault data across the fleet.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: publish 800V fault/arcing characterization work from a university power-electronics lab (fault signatures, hot-swap transients per L02-054 gap); build IP on precharge+interruption topology and arc classification. 2028: 800V/200A benchtop interrupter demo; join OCP as individual contributor; customer discovery with rack OEM protection engineers. 2029: third-party test campaign (interruption life, coordination with upstream breakers); line up pilot LOI with one rack OEM.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: 800VDC racks scale 2027-2029 with ad hoc protection; by 2030 hyperscalers demand listed, standardized protection with telemetry, but grid-breaker incumbents will not have productized rack-level DC units.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Second-generation OCP Mount Diablo 800VDC deployments and 1MW-rack retrofits in 2030-2033 (Kyber-class ramp from 2027, per L02-043/044), plus datacenter electrification capex evidenced by GE Vernova's $2.4B/quarter datacenter orders (L08-033).
competition_outlook_2030: Eaton/Schneider/Vertiv shelf-level products, ABB/Hitachi at feeder level (L08-052), silicon eFuse vendors at board level; expect 2-3 startup entrants. Whitespace is the listed rack-inlet class with fault analytics.
timing_window_risk: If NVIDIA/OCP fold full protection into reference PSUs by 2029, the standalone module shrinks to an IP/licensing play; standards (UL/IEC) may lag and slow procurement.
extreme_edge: Microsecond-class solid-state interruption plus fleet-wide DC arc signature learning at 800-1500VDC, a regime with no incumbent listed product.
first_experiment: 2027-2028: build and demonstrate a 800V/200A solid-state interrupter clearing bolted and arcing faults in <10 us with hot-swap precharge, characterized against recorded rack-inlet transient library; publish and file IP.

concept: Modular medium-voltage DC (1-35kV) hybrid solid-state circuit breaker productized for datacenter campuses, microgrids, and MVDC collection
painful_job: DC fault interruption is the documented showstopper for MVDC: no converged breaker topology, no product category, forcing point-to-point architectures and over-engineered protection while datacenter DC distribution scales.
product: A standardized, modular hybrid SSCB (mechanical ultra-fast disconnect + SiC interruption branch + energy absorber) in 1-35kV/1-4kA frames with coordinated non-unit protection relaying, sold as engineered-but-catalogued units rather than per-project HVDC engineering.
frontier_vision: Enable meshed MVDC campuses and DC industrial parks; expand to MVDC collection for storage/generation and eventually HVDC tap protection.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: comparative topology study and scaled (kV-class) interruption prototypes in a university high-power lab; track ARPA-E DC-GRIDS cohort results (L02-034). 2027: SiC interruption-duty die-characterization study (di/dt, avalanche energy, series sharing vs press-pack IGBT baselines) and fail-short press-pack qualification concept - device-strategy workstream imported from wave-F seed F-08 (2026-07-13); cheap, publishable, and feeds the module design regardless of breaker-market timing (L08-001/003/004/017). 2028: 10kV single-module interruption demo at a national-lab test facility (ORNL SSCB lineage, L08-051); IP on module scaling and relay coordination. 2029: co-develop requirements with one hyperscaler campus power team and one DC-GRIDS performer; secure test-bed MOU.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: MVDC datacenter/industrial distribution becomes economic ahead of protection availability; 2030 is when first US MVDC campus pilots need catalogued breakers, before ABB/Hitachi commit to a productized mid-voltage line.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: US MVDC campus distribution pilots and DC-GRIDS-seeded utility demonstrations reaching procurement 2030-2033 (ARPA-E DC-GRIDS 2026 awards, L02-034; datacenter electrification order growth, L08-033; Southern Spirit-class HVDC construction from 2029, L08-041).
competition_outlook_2030: Hitachi Energy hybrid breaker heritage (L08-052), Siemens/GE per-project offerings, 1-2 ARPA-E-spun startups; academic topologies still non-converged (L08-001/003/004), so productization discipline is the differentiator.
timing_window_risk: MVDC adoption could stay point-to-point (breaker-avoiding) longer than expected; per-project incumbents may bundle protection into converter stations.
extreme_edge: Millisecond-to-microsecond staged interruption with no natural current zero at tens of kV - the hardest unsolved switching problem in power delivery.
first_experiment: 2028: 10kV/2kA hybrid module interrupting a simulated pole-to-pole fault in <2 ms with >=100 operations without refurbishment, at a national-lab or university high-power facility.

concept: Containerized MW-class grid-emulation test system for NERC PRC-029-1 / ride-through verification of inverter-based resources at plant sites
named_buyer_examples: US battery-storage and solar owner-operators subject to PRC-029-1
GE Vernova and other inverter OEMs
painful_job: NERC PRC-029-1 (FERC Order 909, July 2025) imposes ride-through requirements on the US IBR fleet; owners and OEMs lack field-deployable MW-scale hardware to verify plant-level ride-through, and grid-forming claims are contested in procurement (NESO awarded zero GFM contracts).
product: A trailerized 1-5 MW back-to-back converter grid emulator (voltage/frequency/phase-jump event playback, weak-grid emulation) with automated PRC-029/IEEE-2800-style test sequencing and evidence-grade reporting.
frontier_vision: The standard verification instrument for a re-inverterized grid: ride-through, grid-forming capability attestation, and interconnection model validation as a hardware-anchored service network.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: track PRC-029 compliance guidance and audit findings; design event-playback converter control in an academic/PHIL lab; interview 20+ owner-operators and 5 OEM compliance teams. 2028: 250kW prototype emulator validated against lab PHIL benchmarks. 2029: MW-unit design freeze, LOIs from two owner-operators facing re-verification. FIX gate (2027): obtain written regional-entity compliance guidance or two owner-operator LOIs evidencing that PRC-029 verification will require/pay for field MW hardware rather than EMT-model submissions; if model-based compliance suffices, kill the standalone thesis and fold the test-sequencing/reporting stack into P3R2-E-14's qualification platform.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: Enforcement and event-triggered re-verification peak in the early 2030s as the standard beds in and the IBR fleet grows; incumbent test-equipment firms sell lab simulators, not field MW hardware.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: NERC PRC-029-1 compliance/enforcement phase-in and post-disturbance re-verification wave across the US IBR fleet, 2030-2034 (L08-043). CONDITION (unproven): the standard may be satisfiable with EMT-model evidence alone; field MW-hardware demand must be affirmatively documented (regional-entity guidance or owner LOIs) by 2027 or the seed fails. GFM-attestation leg dropped: no US operator GFM procurement spec exists in the atlas and the closest procurement evidence is negative (NESO awarded zero GFM contracts); AEMO precedent (L08-048) retained as watch-item only, not as demand.
competition_outlook_2030: NREL/Sandia lab facilities (non-commercial), PHIL vendors (OPAL-RT/Typhoon class) at lab scale, engineering consultancies with models only; syncon vendors (L08-036/037) as substitute stability providers rather than verifiers. Positioning per adjudication: field-hardware complement to P3R2-E-14's relay/HIL qualification platform, not a competitor to it.
timing_window_risk: If NERC accepts model-based (EMT simulation) compliance evidence broadly, field hardware demand shrinks to OEM labs; regulatory softening is possible.
extreme_edge: Playing back real grid disturbance records at MW power into a live plant - hardware-in-the-loop at fleet scale.
first_experiment: 2028: 250kW grid-emulator prototype reproducing a recorded multi-phase-jump disturbance within 2% envelope error against a PHIL reference, with automated PRC-029-format reporting.

concept: Merchant quench detection and magnet protection subsystem for HTS magnets (fiber-optic + RF sensing + fast energy extraction control)
sector_cluster: Fusion and high-field magnet supply chain
painful_job: HTS magnets lack a validated fast quench-detection/protection method at multi-tesla, multi-megajoule scale; builders choose between no-insulation windings (poor control) or unproven detection - a warranty and schedule risk on every magnet sold.
product: A qualified protection stack: distributed fiber-optic and RF/acoustic quench sensing, sub-millisecond detection electronics, and coordinated energy-extraction/protection control, sold as a subsystem to magnet builders and labs with an acceptance-test protocol.
frontier_vision: The protection and health-monitoring layer for the HTS era: fusion pilot plants, compact NMR/accelerator magnets, and eventually superconducting datacenter/grid hardware.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: instrument sub-scale REBCO coils in a university/lab magnet program; benchmark fiber vs voltage-tap vs RF detection latency on driven quenches; publish and patent sensor-fusion method. 2028: retrofit demo on a mid-scale coil at a DOE lab; define acceptance metrics with two magnet builders. 2029: pilot protection rack on a customer test coil; reliability dossier.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: SPARC-era results (2026-27) convert into ARC-class and DOE milestone pilot-plant magnet procurements in the early 2030s; merchant magnet sales (CFS to Realta/WHAM) show buyers already exist for magnet subsystems rather than in-house-only builds.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: DOE Milestone-Based Fusion Development Program follow-on awards and fusion pilot-plant magnet procurements 2030-2034 (program through FY2027 with renewal decision, L03-032; CFS external magnet sales, L03-035; Tokamak Energy/TE Magnetics commercialization, L03-033/044).
competition_outlook_2030: In-house protection teams at CFS/TE, instrumentation improvisation at labs; no established merchant vendor; possible entry by test-and-measurement firms if the market proves out.
timing_window_risk: Fusion schedule slip compresses orders; magnet builders may insist on keeping protection in-house as core IP.
extreme_edge: Detecting a millimeter-scale normal zone in a 20 T, multi-hundred-MJ REBCO coil and acting within milliseconds - the highest-stakes detection problem in applied superconductivity.
first_experiment: 2027: driven-quench campaign on an instrumented sub-scale REBCO pancake comparing fiber/RF/voltage detection latency and false-positive rates; target <5 ms reliable detection with <1 false trip per 1,000 ramp cycles.

concept: US merchant NEG-coating and low-outgassing surface engineering line for UHV/XHV chambers (accelerators, quantum, EUV, space simulation)
painful_job: NEG coating - the pumping architecture accelerators specify - is effectively single-sourced globally (SAES), and hydrogen-outgassing control still requires 30-hour 250C bakeouts baked into every chamber schedule; US labs and OEMs carry single-point-of-supply and schedule risk.
product: A domestic merchant coating line: NEG (TiZrV-class) sputter coating of beam pipes and chambers, vacuum-firing/low-H treatment, and certified outgassing metrology, sold per-part with quality data - a second source with US supply-chain preference.
frontier_vision: Own engineered vacuum surfaces: from accelerator beam pipes to XHV quantum and EUV chambers, then integrated getter-pump products.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: replicate published NEG-coating recipes on a university sputter rig; validate pumping speed/activation temperature against literature; survey US lab procurement specs. 2028: coat and qualify pilot beam-pipe sections for one DOE lab under a cooperative agreement; certify outgassing test bench to lab standards. 2029: production-line design, LOIs from two labs and one chamber OEM.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: US accelerator upgrade projects and quantum/EUV chamber demand rise into the 2030s while the sole incumbent remains foreign and capacity-limited; domestic-sourcing preferences strengthen for DOE-funded procurement.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: DOE accelerator-upgrade and QIS-facility construction procurements 2030-2034 (DOE $625M QIS centers, L13-028) plus continuing ITER-class vacuum tenders (L07-041/042/043/044) and NASA facility sustainment (L07-035).
competition_outlook_2030: SAES Getters (sole merchant incumbent, L07-037), in-house coating at CERN-affiliated labs, general vacuum houses without NEG physics; ULVAC-class majors could enter if the niche grows.
timing_window_risk: Niche size may stay small if accelerator budgets stall; SAES could add US capacity and close the sovereignty gap.
extreme_edge: Reducing hydrogen outgassing by >10,000x and replacing lumped pumps with the chamber wall itself as the pump.
first_experiment: 2027: deposit TiZrV NEG on 1-m test pipes, demonstrate activation at <=200C and sticking coefficients within 20% of published SAES-class performance, verified by an independent lab outgassing bench.

concept: Cryogenic I/O scaling stack: high-density flex interconnect with integrated 4K LNA/multiplexing modules for 1,000+ qubit machines
named_buyer_examples: DOE QIS centers (Fermilab SQMS, Brookhaven C2QA, Argonne Q-NEXT, LBNL QSA, ORNL QSC)
painful_job: Cryo wiring density (256 channels/loader today) is an order of magnitude short of thousand-qubit machines, and cryo-LNA/cryo-CMOS power budgets collide with dilution-refrigerator cooling limits; the only roadmap is one EU vendor's unvalidated projection.
product: A US-manufactured cryo I/O product line: superconducting/thin-film flex ribbon looms with engineered thermal anchoring, plus integrated 4K modules (LNA + cryo multiplexing) qualified for heat load per channel - sold as channels-per-watt, not cables.
frontier_vision: The interconnect backbone for cryogenic computing and sensing: quantum computers, cryo-CMOS test, and superconducting detector arrays for science and defense.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: thermal/microwave modeling and prototype flex looms in a university cryo lab; measure heat load and crosstalk at 4K/100mK vs coax baselines. 2028: integrate a 4-8x cryo mux + LNA module at 4K within a <2 mW/channel budget; engage two DOE QIS centers as evaluation sites. 2029: pilot loom in a working dilution refrigerator at a national lab; reliability cycling data; manufacturing plan.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: Machines cross the few-hundred to few-thousand qubit range around 2030; DOE domestic-supply-chain preference (Fermilab-Qblox precedent, Bluefors Syracuse) favors a US interconnect vendor just as I/O becomes the binding constraint.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: DOE QIS center renewals and 1,000+ qubit-class system builds 2030-2033 (DOE $625M QIS funding, L13-028; Keysight 1,000+ qubit control delivery signal, L13-037; Fermilab-Qblox domestic manufacturing CRADA, L13-032).
competition_outlook_2030: Delft Circuits (EU incumbent, L13-042), Bluefors integrated offerings (L13-041), in-house wiring at large players; cryo-CMOS (if it matures) partially substitutes by moving control cold.
timing_window_risk: Cryo-CMOS breakthroughs or optical links could cut needed coax/flex channel counts; quantum funding continuity risk.
extreme_edge: Thousands of microwave channels into a 10 mK environment at milliwatt total heat load - interconnect at the thermodynamic floor.
first_experiment: 2027-2028: 64-channel flex loom + 4K mux/LNA module demonstrating <=2 mW/channel total dissipation and qubit-grade noise temperature in a host dilution refrigerator at a DOE lab.

concept: Standardized solid-state pulsed-power modulator platform (common modules, common interconnect) for linacs, cargo scanners, RF sources, and industrial beams
painful_job: Solid-state modulator replacement of thyratron/PFN chains is proceeding lab-by-lab with at least five incompatible designs and no module/interconnect standard; every US accelerator project re-engineers pulsed power, and no US merchant vendor anchors the category.
product: A catalogued Marx/solid-state modulator family (50-150kV, 10-500A class) built from one qualified switch-module and one control/diagnostic backbone, with published acceptance-test protocol aligned to IEC 60060-1:2025 - klystron, magnetron, and e-beam drive from the same building blocks.
frontier_vision: Become the US pulsed-power standard: from cargo scanners and medical linacs to fusion RF drive and flash radiography module supply.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: design the standard switch module; validate on a university 30kV testbed; publish standardization concept building on the documented gap. 2028: 100kV/100A stack demo driving a surplus klystron at a lab partner; ARDAP/SBIR-track funding for qualification. 2029: pilot units placed with one linac OEM and one DOE lab; MTBF data collection.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: Thyratron obsolescence and cargo/security linac growth (Varex industrial +25% YoY) mature into a replacement/expansion cycle in the early 2030s; European project-shops (Jema, ScandiNova) do not serve US OEM volumes with a standardized catalog.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: US cargo-scanning fleet expansion and accelerator-stewardship procurement 2030-2034 (Varex $845M FY2025 with >$55M new cargo orders, L05-033; DOE ARDAP 70-institution funding base, L05-031; SLAC GREEN-RF commercialization push, L05-032).
competition_outlook_2030: ScandiNova (SE, L05-047), Jema (ES, L05-030), CPI in-house (L05-050), lab in-house builds; no US standardized merchant line expected absent this entry.
timing_window_risk: OEMs may vertically integrate modulators; procurement cycles in security/medical are slow and certification-heavy.
extreme_edge: One qualified module scaling from 10 kW medical pulses to MW-class RF drive with sub-percent droop - pulsed power as a product, not a project.
first_experiment: 2028: 100kV/100A/5us solid-state modulator built from 12 identical modules driving a klystron load with <1% flat-top droop and demonstrated module hot-swap; independent witness test per IEC 60060-1.

concept: Traceable ultra-high-dose-rate (FLASH) beam-current and dose-rate metrology instrument for clinical and industrial electron beams
named_buyer_examples: US clinical linac OEMs developing FLASH
painful_job: Beam current transformers demonstrably mis-read under FLASH-regime transient charge buildup - two independent 2024-25 groups are still chasing fixes - so device makers and sterilization operators lack traceable dose-rate evidence exactly where regulators demand it.
product: A UHDR-hardened beam monitor (compensated toroid + fast electro-optic/faraday channel) with calibration methodology designed for traceability, sold with per-unit calibration certificates for FLASH R&D and e-beam/X-ray sterilization QA under ISO 11137-1:2025.
frontier_vision: The dosimetry backbone for ultra-fast beams: FLASH therapy, industrial UHDR processing, and accelerator pulse metrology.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: replicate published UHDR error mechanisms on a university linac; prototype compensated sensor; engage NIST-adjacent calibration expertise. 2028: cross-validate against calorimetric dosimetry at two beam facilities; publish traceability method. 2029: pilot units in one FLASH research program and one sterilization plant QA lab.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: FLASH pivotal clinical work and expanding e-beam sterilization both need regulator-grade dose-rate evidence in the early 2030s; incumbent BCT vendors sell catalog parts not validated in this regime.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: First FLASH radiotherapy regulatory submissions/clearances expected early 2030s (inference from current trial stage - flagged) plus ISO 11137-1:2025-driven revalidation in the growing e-beam sterilization base (L05-042, L05-028).
competition_outlook_2030: Bergoz (FR, catalog BCTs, L05-049), in-house physics groups at linac OEMs, ionization-chamber dosimetry vendors (fail at UHDR); small entrant field.
timing_window_risk: FLASH clinical adoption could slip past 2034; market may remain instrument-scale (tens of $M) rather than platform-scale.
extreme_edge: Accurate charge metrology at dose rates 1,000x conventional therapy, where standard sensors physically saturate.
first_experiment: 2027: side-by-side UHDR beam test showing <2% current-reading error where conventional BCTs show the published transient errors, validated against calorimetry.

concept: Compact self-shielded solid-state e-beam/X-ray sterilization cell for in-house medical-device sterilization (EtO exit)
painful_job: EtO replacement demand has the two pure-play e-beam vendors (IBA, L3) backlogged into 2026-27; device makers who need new non-EtO capacity face multi-year waits and central-plant logistics instead of in-line, in-house sterilization.
product: A factory-floor sterilization cell: 3-10 MeV solid-state-modulator-driven accelerator, integrated self-shielding, conveyor, and ISO 11137-compliant dosimetry/records - sized for a single device plant's throughput, serviceable like a machine tool rather than a facility.
frontier_vision: Distributed sterilization: every major device plant runs its own beam, then food and bioprocess applications on the same platform.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: system architecture and shielding/regulatory study (state radiation-control licensing pathfinding); modulator/accelerator subscale work shared with the modulator platform program. 2028: dose-mapping demo on a rented industrial beamline with target product families; LOI discussions with two device OEMs. 2029: full engineering design + certification plan; anchor-customer term sheet.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: EtO capacity pressure persists while incumbent e-beam suppliers stay backlogged and central; by 2030 device OEMs will fund in-house capacity if a productized cell exists.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Continuing EtO-replacement capacity procurement evidenced by IBA/L3 backlogs and named new lines (L05-028) and revalidation demand under ISO 11137-1:2025 (L05-042); trigger strength depends on US EtO regulatory tightening (flagged: EPA rule not in accepted ledger - must be re-sourced in P4).
competition_outlook_2030: IBA and L3 Applied Technologies (central high-power systems), Varex (sources, not cells), possible Chinese vendors (CGN Dasheng) excluded from US medical supply by procurement preference; startup field thin.
timing_window_risk: If EtO restrictions stall or incumbents scale capacity fast, in-house economics weaken; radiation-licensing friction per site is real.
extreme_edge: Shrinking a building-scale irradiation facility into a shielded machine cell with solid-state reliability.
first_experiment: 2028: validated dose-uniformity map (DUR <1.5) on representative device loads using a rented 10 MeV beamline plus a certified techno-economic model vs contract-sterilization pricing, reviewed by an independent sterilization consultant.

concept: Vendor-neutral ion-energy-distribution metrology + tailored-waveform bias control retrofit for plasma etch chambers
named_buyer_examples: US leading-edge fabs (Intel/Micron archetype, CHIPS-funded expansions)
AMEC (CN, via partitioned >=28nm entity, from B-05)
NAURA / Piotech (CN, via partitioned >=28nm entity, from B-05)
painful_job: Tailored-voltage-waveform biasing for atomic-scale etch is an unsettled 2024-26 research frontier; fabs and OEMs lack independent ion-energy-distribution measurement and closed-loop waveform control - they tune blind against drifting sheaths at sub-2nm nodes.
product: A chamber-mounted IEDF sensor (RF-immune retarding analyzer / derived-signal estimator) plus a waveform-synthesis bias controller that closes the loop on ion energy rather than on electrical setpoints; retrofits onto existing generators. Merged extensions: (1) company structure = two-entity export partition (from C-06) - the US entity serves leading-edge OCP/fab customers, a separate CN-serving line is limited to mature-node (>=28nm) applications; (2) CN product chapter (from B-05): waveform-bias RF delivery for AMEC/NAURA/Piotech-class OEM localization programs, mature-node scope only; (3) arc/ESC-discharge event-detection and forensics layer (from B-21), contingent on FTO analysis - patent-dense field.
frontier_vision: Ion-energy-defined processing as the control standard across etch, deposition, and emerging plasma applications - the measurement layer incumbent generator vendors do not own.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: build IEDF estimation methods on a university ICP/CCP reactor; benchmark against gridded analyzers; publish and patent sensor+control coupling. 2028: alpha retrofit on an OEM lab chamber under JDA; quantify etch-profile improvement on test wafers. 2029: SEMI-standards engagement and pilot with one US fab process-development group. Merged gates: export-control counsel review of the two-entity partition is a 2027 gate (before any CN-facing work); FTO analysis precedes any investment in the B-21 event-detection layer. KR validation channel (from E-03): Samsung TVW co-authorship pull (L06-009) and the Korean plasma-diagnostics base (L06-024/025) as reference-user and validation channel.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: Waveform-capable generators (AE Everest class) proliferate 2026-29, creating the installed base that then needs independent metrology and control by 2030; generator vendors sell sources, not vendor-neutral measurement.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: US: sub-2nm/backside-power etch capacity ramps at CHIPS-funded US fabs 2030-2033 and second-generation waveform-bias platform adoption (Advanced Energy new-platform ramp evidence, L06-039). CN (independent leg, merged from B-05/C-06; mature-node scope): AMEC/NAURA/Piotech supplier-localization programs under the 15th FYP - AMEC etch revenue RMB7.28bn +54.7% (L06-048), the Hengyunchang/Injet domestic-substitution wave (L06-042/043/044), and the <12% RF/precision-component localization gap (L06-054) those OEMs are documented to be closing; served only through the partitioned >=28nm entity, subject to the 2027 export-counsel gate.
competition_outlook_2030: Advanced Energy/MKS/Comet embedding partial capability in generators (L06-039, L06-049); Impedans-class plasma diagnostics; tool-OEM internal sensors. Neutral closed-loop IEDF control remains open.
timing_window_risk: OEMs may lock chamber data behind proprietary interfaces; if generator vendors integrate good-enough IEDF inference by 2030 the retrofit market narrows to process-development labs.
extreme_edge: Controlling ion energy distributions to electron-volt precision through an RF sheath at 100+ MHz superposition - measurement where physics fights the measurement.
first_experiment: 2027-2028: closed-loop IEDF control demo on a lab reactor holding a programmed bimodal ion-energy peak within +/-2 eV across intentional pressure/chemistry drift; correlate to etch-profile metrics.

concept: Sub-100ms no-overshoot gas delivery: pressure-insensitive fast MFC with inline transient metrology for ALD/ALE throughput
named_buyer_examples: etch/deposition tool OEMs (Lam/Applied archetype via gas-panel integrators)
painful_job: SEMI E17 codifies transient response as the constraint; thermal MFCs still overshoot on fast steps, and ALD/ALE cycle counts keep rising - gas switching time is now direct throughput money on $100M+ tools fleets.
product: A fast-actuation MFC (pressure-based sensing + model-predictive valve control) hitting sub-100 ms settled steps without overshoot, plus an inline transient-verification module that gives OEMs SEMI E17-style evidence per channel.
frontier_vision: The gas-delivery timing layer for atomic-layer processing everywhere - semiconductors first, then precision CVD industries.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-27: control-theory and sensor work on a lab flow bench (building on estimated-output-feedback literature); prototype actuator/sensing stack. 2028: third-party SEMI E17-protocol characterization vs incumbent MFCs; JDA discussions with one gas-panel integrator. 2029: alpha units on an OEM development tool; reliability data. FIX additions: 2026-27 includes a quantified $/tool/year throughput-value model vs OEM qualification switching costs, and broadening of the technical base beyond L06-026/L06-034 (additional peer-reviewed transient-flow sources to be added in P4). Hard 2028 gate: a paid evaluation or LOI from one gas-panel integrator/OEM evidencing dual-sourcing appetite on transient specs; absent it, shelve the seed.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: ALD/ALE step counts and gas-panel channel counts keep climbing through 2030; incumbents optimize steady-state accuracy and are slow to re-architect sensing; a demonstrable throughput delta converts to design-ins on next tool generations 2030-2033.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Next-generation US fab tool builds 2030-2033 (CHIPS-funded capacity, Edwards subfab precedent L06-033) and an expected SEMI E17 revision cycle tightening transient specs (standard vintage evidence, L06-035).
competition_outlook_2030: Horiba/Brooks/MKS/Fujikin incumbent MFC lines (market structure via L07-049 gas-panel concentration); pressure-based fast MFCs may partially close the gap - differentiation must be verified transient evidence.
timing_window_risk: Incumbent catch-up is the main risk; OEM qualification cycles are long and single-sourced relationships sticky. Adjudication: incumbent (Horiba/Brooks/MKS) catch-up could close the window before 2030; the 2028 dual-sourcing gate is the go/no-go.
extreme_edge: Metering reactive gases to 1% in tens of milliseconds against varying upstream pressure - flow control at chemical-reaction timescales.
first_experiment: 2027: bench demonstration of 0-90% flow steps settling <100 ms with zero overshoot across 2x upstream-pressure variation, measured by an independent rate-of-rise standard.

concept: Cycling-tolerant printed-circuit heat exchangers (PCHE) as a catalogued product line for sCO2, advanced-nuclear, and geothermal power blocks
painful_job: PCHE recuperators are the most-cited sCO2 bottleneck: thermal-cycling durability is unresolved, every integrator builds bespoke units, and there is no sCO2 acceptance-test standard - buyers negotiate one-off guarantees for the costliest component in the cycle.
product: A standardized PCHE family engineered for rapid thermal transients (validated to defined C/min ramp classes), with published creep/fatigue qualification per ASTM E139-class methods and a standing acceptance-test protocol - sold as catalog frames with delivery times, not EPC subprojects.

concept: Precision thermal qualification instrumentation for liquid/two-phase cooling: reference thermal test vehicles, calorimetry CDU/cold-plate benches, and post-PFAS fluid qualification rigs

China Isotope & Radiation Corp / Atom Hi-Tech - 2024 centralized self-shielded cyclotron tender for three medical-isotope centers (L05-036)
IHEP/CEPC RF program as high-end expansion channel (L05-012, L05-013)
painful_job: Every accelerator project integrates a bespoke modulator: at least five independent, non-interoperable solid-state modulator/SSPA designs documented (L05-003 through L05-009), no accelerator-specific pulsed-power acceptance standard beyond generic IEC HV tests, and vacuum-device output couplers remain a top failure item at high CW power (L05-014). China's industrial-accelerator demand is growing and disclosed (L05-035, L05-036) while modulator supply is fragmented imports (ScandiNova L05-047, Jema L05-030) or in-house builds.
product: A modular IGBT-Marx modulator platform: 50-150 kV, 100 A-class, ms-pulse family built from one qualified 3 kV brick (mechanism: series-stacked bricks with per-stage droop correction and fiber-synchronized gate timing), standard control/diagnostic API, klystron/magnetron/e-beam-gun variants - sold to Chinese accelerator integrators and system OEMs.
frontier_vision: The 'server-power-supply moment' for pulsed power: one standardized brick family powering sterilization, NDT, cargo scanning, medical linacs, and eventually collider RF stations.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-2027: design + single-brick (3 kV) qualification; assemble 10-stage 30 kV stack in university lab; publish droop-correction performance. 2027-2028: 100 kV/50 A prototype driving a dummy klystron load; reliability run (10^7 pulses); patents on brick interconnect + fault-isolation. 2028-2029: co-test with an Asian accelerator lab; customer discovery with Chinese integrators (CGN Dasheng channel via HK trading structures where lawful); pre-certify to IEC HV test methods.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: China's e-beam/isotope infrastructure is scaling on disclosed multi-hundred-MRMB order books now (L05-035/036); modulators are the recurring cost/reliability bottleneck; no standard platform exists globally (documented fragmentation), so a 2030 productized brick family enters an unconsolidated niche that big vendors ignore (too custom) and labs under-productize.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Named: (a) CGN Dasheng's accelerator order-book growth trajectory (L05-035) implying fleet buildout and replacement demand into 2030-2034; (b) China Isotope & Radiation's medical-isotope center program (L05-036) requiring cyclotron/linac power systems; (c) CEPC decision window - IHEP's high-efficiency klystron program (78.5% achieved, 80.5% target, L05-012/013) creates a named future demand pole for standardized modulators if approved in the 15th FYP (approval uncertainty flagged).
competition_outlook_2030: ScandiNova (L05-047) and Jema (L05-030) defend the import channel; CGN/CAEP in-house teams build for themselves; expect a Chinese modulator startup from the CAS ecosystem. Win via cost-per-pulse reliability data and the standardized-brick logistics story.
timing_window_risk: Nuclear-SOE procurement (CGN) is hard for foreign vendors - enter via medical/NDT integrators and JV licensing; dual-use export-control review required for high-power pulsed hardware. Access risk medium-high.
commercial_readiness_kill_date: 2034-06-30: kill if no Chinese integrator purchase/license and no lab co-test by mid-2034.
extreme_edge: Same bricks scale to fusion-adjacent LTD-style drivers and DEW pulse supplies (export-controlled paths excluded from plan).
first_experiment: 2027-Q3: 10-stage Marx stack delivers 30 kV/50 A, 1 ms flat-top pulses with <1% droop at 100 Hz for 10^6 pulses without stage failure; success also requires demonstrated single-stage fault ride-through.

concept: HTS conductor and coil QC instrumentation: reel-to-reel critical-current/defect mapping plus quench-detection/protection electronics for Chinese tape makers and fusion magnet programs
named_buyer_examples: Shanghai Superconductor / Shanghai International Superconducting Tech (built and operates the State Grid Shanghai 35 kV commercial HTS cable, L03-041, L03-052)
Western Superconducting Technologies (ITER strand supplier, L03-031)
ASIPP Hefei (35.1 T hybrid magnet record 2025, L03-029/L03-037; CFETR magnet engineering L03-024)
painful_job: REBCO conductors degrade via strain, delamination and screening-current stress at high field (L03-018, L03-020, L03-021); tape capacity is concentrated in under 10 vendors and single fusion orders can absorb large shares of output (L03-019), so every meter shipped to a magnet program must be QC-mapped and every coil needs trustworthy quench detection - while Chinese buyers (State Grid cable projects L03-041, ASIPP magnets L03-029) are scaling faster than any standardized QC/quench instrumentation supply.
product: Two coupled product lines: (1) reel-to-reel Ic + defect mapper (mechanism: continuous transport-current/contactless Hall-array scanning with in-line strain stress screening) producing per-meter conductor passports; (2) coil quench-detection/protection electronics using multi-modal sensing (voltage taps + fast fiber/acoustic channels) with microsecond discrimination logic, sold as instrument racks to tape factories, cable projects, and magnet labs.
frontier_vision: Become the metrology-and-protection layer of the global HTS industry - every tape meter passported, every magnet protected - expanding into cable commissioning and in-service monitoring.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-2027: build benchtop Ic scanner (LN2, 77 K) in university lab; validate against tape samples from multiple vendors; publish defect-detection sensitivity study. 2027-2028: quench-detection testbed on small REBCO coils; multi-modal discrimination algorithms validated against induced quenches; patents. 2028-2029: pilot passporting service with one tape maker (HK/Shanghai research collaboration), spec productized reel-to-reel line; engage fusion-program QA teams on requirements.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: HTS magnet demand inflects with fusion programs and grid cables in the late 2020s; QC/protection instrumentation is the picks-and-shovels layer that scales with conductor volume regardless of which magnet projects win; nobody has standardized it (bespoke acceptance testing documented), and China's conductor base is expanding to reduce import dependence (L03-052).
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Named: (a) CFETR/China fusion magnet procurement decision expected post-ITER in the 15th FYP window (design complete, construction start undated - uncertainty explicitly flagged, L03-024); (b) ASIPP's escalating high-field program (35.1 T record 2025, L03-029/037); (c) State Grid HTS cable follow-ons after the Shanghai 'fully commercial' installation (L03-041 - single-installation caveat preserved).
competition_outlook_2030: Tape makers' in-house rigs (default substitute); instrument boutiques in EU/JP; Chinese institutes building their own. Win via throughput (reel-to-reel speed), passport data infrastructure, and neutrality between vendor and buyer.
timing_window_risk: Foreign-founder access comparatively good (instrumentation, not controlled magnet tech), but fusion-program procurement may be China-only - sell to tape merchants and via HK entity; CFETR timing slip is the main demand risk (explicitly undated in atlas).
commercial_readiness_kill_date: 2034-12-31: kill if neither a tape-maker install nor a fusion-program order by end-2034.
extreme_edge: Quench-discrimination electronics evolve into flight-grade protection for HTS motors/generators.
first_experiment: 2027-Q2: benchtop reel-to-reel scanner detects seeded micro-defects (>=90% detection, <5% false positive) at >=10 m/min on commercial REBCO tape at 77 K; success benchmarked against destructive Ic sampling.

concept: Skid-mounted kW-class 4-20 K cryogenic plant modules for mid-scale Chinese HTS, accelerator, and fusion-adjacent programs (between lab cryocoolers and bespoke helium plants)
named_buyer_examples: State Grid HTS cable cooling stations (Shanghai cable operating since 2021, L03-041)
IHEP-class facility programs (procurement style evidenced by HEPS tenders, L07-045)
painful_job: Catalog cryocoolers deliver mW-to-W class cooling (PT205: 10 mW at 2.5 K for 1.1 kW input, L03-050) while flagship plants are bespoke kW-class installations (JT-60SA ~9.5 kW-equivalent context, L03-025/026); mid-scale magnet/cable projects have no standardized, repeatable 100 W-1 kW @ 4-20 K product, creating cost/schedule risk for every new Chinese HTS deployment (cable stations L03-041; high-field labs L03-029).
product: Standardized cryoplant skids: turbo-Brayton/pulse-tube hybrid modules delivering 100 W-1 kW at 10-20 K (HTS regime) with N+1 redundancy, automated cooldown control, and remote monitoring - productized like industrial chillers rather than engineered plants.
frontier_vision: Cryogenics-as-a-utility for the superconducting economy: fleets of standard skids cooling cables, fault-current limiters, magnets and quantum facilities.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-2027: thermodynamic architecture study + compressor/expander vendor mapping; sub-scale (50 W @ 20 K) lab demonstrator. 2027-2028: reliability engineering of the skid controller; publish cost-per-watt analysis vs bespoke plants; patents on cooldown-automation and redundancy switchover. 2028-2029: partner-lab field trial adjacent to an HTS testbed; JV/licensing discussions with Chinese cryo manufacturers.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: HTS deployments multiply post-2030 (fusion + grid); the mid-scale cooling gap is documented and persistent; incumbents build projects, not products - a productized skid line at 2030 rides the deployment curve.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Named: CFETR/BEST-era Chinese fusion facility buildout (post-ITER decision window, L03-024 - undated, flagged) and State Grid HTS cable replication beyond Shanghai (L03-041); ASIPP facility expansion (L03-029/037).
competition_outlook_2030: Global cryoplant majors (bespoke, expensive), Chinese cryocooler makers scaling up, institute in-house plants. Differentiation: standardization + fleet reliability. Note: competitive intel in atlas is thin (vendor spec L03-050 only) - P4 must map Chinese cryo industry before promotion.
timing_window_risk: Capital-intensive; China-only procurement rules at big-science buyers (L07-045) force JV; Chinese cryo industry may close this gap domestically before 2030 - treat as optional/extra seed pending P4 competitor mapping.
commercial_readiness_kill_date: 2033-12-31: kill if P4 competitor mapping shows domestic skid products already shipping, or no partner-lab trial by end-2033.
extreme_edge: Same skids serve hydrogen-liquefaction boil-off management and space-simulation chambers.
first_experiment: 2028-Q2: 50 W @ 20 K demonstrator achieves >=95% availability over a 1,000 h unattended run with automated cooldown/recovery; cost model validated within 20%.

concept: NEG-coating and low-outgassing surface-engineering line (equipment + licensed process) for Chinese UHV chamber fabricators serving accelerators, quantum labs, and semicon
named_buyer_examples: China-registered vacuum-chamber manufacturers who alone may bid IHEP/HEPS-class tenders (China-only bid rule documented, L07-045)
IHEP itself for beampipe processing capacity (L07-045)
Chinese quantum/semicon chamber fabricators (UHV demand fronts, L07-030-class context)
painful_job: Hydrogen outgassing control requires energy- and schedule-intensive bakeout (250C/30 h for >70,000x reduction, L07-009; supporting physics L07-008), and distributed NEG pumping - academically mature since the 1990s (L07-001) - is commercially concentrated in essentially one vendor (SAES, L07-037), while China's big-science vacuum procurement is restricted to domestic manufacturers (L07-045) who lack an in-country NEG-coating/outgassing-engineering supply base.
product: A licensed production cell: magnetron-sputtered TiZrV NEG coating line for beampipes/chambers (mechanism: getter film pumps residual gas after low-temperature activation, replacing lumped pumps), plus vacuum-firing/bakeout optimization service and witness-sample outgassing metrology - sold as equipment + process license + QA protocol to Chinese fabricators.
frontier_vision: The surface-engineering layer of the vacuum world: NEG-coated compact systems for accelerators, quantum hardware, and eventually portable UHV instruments.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-2027: replicate TiZrV coating performance on a lab sputtering rig; build outgassing metrology bench (throughput method); publish activation-temperature/pumping-speed data. 2027-2028: pilot-coat real beampipe geometries; develop QA witness protocol; patents on coating-uniformity fixtures for long narrow pipes. 2028-2029: license negotiation with 1-2 Chinese chamber makers (structure: HK IP entity + domestic licensee to fit the China-only tender rule); requirements discovery with IHEP vacuum group.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: China's light-source/collider pipeline keeps procuring domestically (HEPS precedent, L07-045); the NEG single-vendor global bottleneck (L07-037) plus domestic-bid rules make a licensed in-China coating cell the natural 2030 entry - low commoditization risk because process know-how, not hardware, is the moat.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Named: post-HEPS Chinese synchrotron/FEL construction and - if approved in the 15th FYP - CEPC vacuum-system procurement (IHEP program evidenced via its klystron/RF investments, L05-012/013; approval uncertainty flagged); each such machine needs kilometers of NEG-coated chamber from China-registered suppliers (L07-045).
competition_outlook_2030: SAES defending via export sales (L07-037); IHEP in-house coating labs; possibly a CAS spinoff. The licensed-cell model co-opts rather than fights domestic fabricators.
timing_window_risk: Demand is lumpy and government-approval-dependent (CEPC undecided); foreign founder cannot bid directly - licensing structure mandatory; IP leakage risk in process licensing is real (mitigate via consumables + QA lock-ins).
commercial_readiness_kill_date: 2034-12-31: kill if no Chinese license agreement and no new large CN accelerator project approved by end-2034.
extreme_edge: NEG-coated compact chambers enable maintenance-free UHV for portable quantum sensors.
first_experiment: 2027-Q3: lab-coated 2 m narrow-bore pipe demonstrates specified pumping speed and >=20 activation cycles without performance loss, verified on an in-house outgassing bench against published TiZrV benchmarks.

concept: Low-ripple high-current rectification and power-quality retrofit systems (IGBT/MMC hybrid + electrochemical-aware control) for Chinese green-hydrogen plants and electrowinning tank houses
named_buyer_examples: Sinopec (Kuqa 260 MW project documented running below nameplate, L11-049)
China Energy Construction (125-set alkaline+PEM tender, L11-051)
LONGi Hydrogen / Peric / Sungrow Hydrogen as OEM/EPC channels (L11-050, L11-051)
expansion: Chinese copper electrowinning tank houses (rectifier-quality lever, L11-045; electro-refining literature L11-026/027)
painful_job: Six-pulse thyristor rectifiers remain the MW-scale default; documented penalty: up to ~14% specific-energy and ~13% loss reduction available from transistor/MMC-class supplies (L11-016 through L11-021), and ripple/intermittency measurably accelerates stack degradation under renewable coupling (L11-001, L11-003, L11-004, L11-031); Sinopec's flagship Kuqa ran at a fraction of nameplate (L11-049) - power delivery and variable-operation control, not stacks, are the binding quality problem in a market where Chinese stack overcapacity (~2x demand, L11-035, L11-051) has commoditized the cell itself.
product: A rectification/power-quality retrofit skid: IGBT active front end + interleaved DC stage with <1% current ripple at MW scale, electrochemical-aware control (mechanism: degradation-weighted current scheduling that maps renewable variability into stack-safe trajectories per documented stressor physics), harmonic compliance, and per-stack ripple analytics. Same hardware core serves electrolyzers and electrowinning lines (L11-045).
frontier_vision: Own the precision-DC layer of electrochemical industry worldwide - hydrogen, electrowinning, chlor-alkali, e-fuels - selling efficiency as retrofittable hardware.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-2027: hardware-in-loop testbed correlating ripple spectra with degradation proxies on short stacks (replicating L11-016/021 findings); publish; patents on degradation-weighted scheduling. 2027-2028: 100 kW-class AFE+DC prototype with measured efficiency delta vs thyristor baseline; engage one Chinese EPC and one electrowinning operator on retrofit economics (site data collection under NDA-free academic framing). 2028-2029: containerized 1 MW pilot design; pre-agreement with an OEM/EPC channel (LONGi/Peric-class) for 2030 co-deployment.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: Atlas negative finding respected: no stack play - Chinese overcapacity kills stack margins (L11-035/051) but strengthens the efficiency-differentiation case for balance-of-plant power quality; renewable-coupled megaprojects keep tendering (L11-049/050/051) and by 2030 the installed base of underperforming thyristor-fed plants is itself the retrofit market.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Named: continuing Sinopec / China Energy Construction electrolyzer tender cadence in Xinjiang/Inner Mongolia renewable-hydrogen bases documented through 2025-2026 (L11-049, L11-050, L11-051) extending into the 15th FYP; retrofit demand from the documented utilization shortfall at flagship sites (L11-049). 15th-FYP-specific hydrogen targets must be re-verified in P4 (2026 policy baseline only).
competition_outlook_2030: Sungrow - a power-electronics giant already inside hydrogen tenders (L11-051) - is the decisive competitive threat; also rectifier incumbents and OEM in-house BOP. Survive only via electrochemical-aware control IP + neutrality across stack OEMs; if Sungrow ships equivalent ripple specs by 2029, kill early.
timing_window_risk: High: Chinese power-electronics cost curve is brutal; SOE project entry requires EPC partnering; foreign founder must license or JV. Electrowinning expansion lacks named Chinese buyer evidence in atlas (L11-045 is vendor-side) - flagged for P4.
commercial_readiness_kill_date: 2033-06-30: kill if Sungrow/domestic equivalents reach <1% ripple MW-class products before we have a pilot PO (check annually), or no EPC partnership by mid-2033.
extreme_edge: Degradation-aware DC scheduling generalizes to battery formation and CO2 electrolysis when those mature.
first_experiment: 2027-Q2: on a short-stack testbed, demonstrate measured specific-energy improvement >=8% and a quantified degradation-rate reduction under emulated wind/solar profiles for IGBT low-ripple supply vs 6-pulse thyristor baseline over 1,000 h.

concept: Dual-standard megawatt charging/battery-swap interface power conversion: one qualified converter family bridging Chinese GB/T swap ecosystems and IEC TS 63379 MCS static charging for exported mining/port fleets
named_buyer_examples: XCMG - 240t BEV truck supplier to Fortescue with phased 2028-2030 deliveries into an MCS/static-charging market (L10-028)
SPIC Qiyuan - battery-swap mining-truck technology exporter (Oyu Tolgoi deployment, L10-031)
Chinese swap-standard ecosystem players under the national excavator battery-swap standard (L10-046) and CCS battery-ship rules (L10-045)
painful_job: China bet on battery-swap across trucks, excavators and vessels (L10-031, L10-040, L10-045, L10-046) while Western mine/port buyers standardize on CharIN/IEC MCS static megawatt charging (IEC TS 63379, published Feb-2026, L10-050); the atlas documents no cross-recognition between the two ecosystems, so Chinese OEMs exporting equipment (XCMG-Fortescue, L10-028; Liebherr trolley-compatible trucks, L10-052) must engineer bespoke power interfaces per project - a recurring, standards-driven integration tax.
product: A qualified bidirectional 1-3.75 MW DC converter family with swappable interface personalities: GB/T swap-station DC bus profile on one side, IEC TS 63379 MCS (up to 1,250 V/3,000 A) on the other (mechanism: modular SiC DC-DC bricks + certified protocol/interlock stacks for each standard), enabling one truck/vessel platform to serve both ecosystems.
frontier_vision: The interoperability layer of global heavy-fleet electrification - every exported Chinese machine and every mixed-standard mine site runs through our conversion/interlock stack.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-2027: standards deep-dive + protocol/interlock reference implementation for IEC TS 63379 and GB swap profiles; desk validation with CharIN documentation; patents on dual-personality safety interlock arbitration. 2027-2028: 250 kW brick prototype demonstrating both profiles on a battery emulator; publish interop test methodology. 2028-2029: field data partnership targeting one OEM export program (XCMG/SPIC channel via HK entity); pre-certification plan with a test lab. FIX gate (2028): documented evidence that one named export program (XCMG-Fortescue delivery chain or an SPIC swap-export follow-on) will procure dual-standard interface hardware; without it the standalone thesis ends.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: XCMG's Fortescue deliveries run 2028-2030 (L10-028) and swap-vs-MCS non-convergence is documented as of 2026; by 2030 the dual-ecosystem friction is an operating cost with named fleets on both sides - and no converged standard is plausible given three architectures still competing (L10-028/029/031 pattern).
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Named: (a) XCMG-Fortescue phased 240t BEV deliveries 2028-2030 and follow-on Western-market export bids (L10-028); (b) SPIC swap-technology export expansion after Oyu Tolgoi trial concludes end-2026 (L10-031); (c) domestic SOE open-pit equipment tender cadence (China Gold 60-truck-class tenders, L10-034; Baogang retrofit programs, L10-035) electrifying under swap standards (L10-046).
competition_outlook_2030: OEM in-house power teams (XCMG), CATL swap ecosystem (L10-031/040), Western charger vendors implementing MCS only. The neutral dual-standard niche survives if certification burden stays high - which IEC TS 63379's 2026 vintage suggests.
timing_window_risk: Foreign founder is actually advantaged on the IEC/Western-certification side; China-side access via OEM design-in. Risk: a swap-standard export failure (Western mines rejecting swap) would collapse the dual-standard need into MCS-only - monitor Fortescue/Rio architecture choices (L10-028/031). Fold-in path (pre-agreed per adjudication): if the swap architecture fails offshore, the dual-personality converter folds into P3R2-A-21 as its interface-personality module rather than continuing standalone. Demand classification: contingent (an option on standards non-convergence), not a base-demand seed.
commercial_readiness_kill_date: 2034-06-30: kill if no OEM co-development agreement by mid-2034 or if MCS-vs-swap converges to one survivor before 2032.
extreme_edge: Protocol-arbitrated MW interfaces extend to port cranes, e-vessel shore/swap hybrid stations (L10-040/045).
first_experiment: 2028-Q1: 250 kW dual-personality converter passes scripted conformance suites for both IEC TS 63379 signaling and a GB swap-station DC profile on a battery emulator, including cross-standard fault-interlock scenarios.

concept: Industrial plasma power-and-matching platform (pulsed DC/RF with arc management) for Chinese non-semiconductor plasma equipment: PECVD coating, PCB plasma cleaning, surface treatment
named_buyer_examples: Chinese PCB makers tendering plasma cleaning machines (Wuxi Shennan Circuit tender, L01-114)
defense-industrial PECVD buyers evidencing institutional demand (AVIC Xi'an FACRI award, L01-039 - demand signal, not a target account)
Chinese plasma-tool OEM ecosystem growing with NAURA/Piotech/ACM (L01-044)
painful_job: Chinese industrial (non-semi) plasma equipment builders buy imported RF generators/matches (AE/MKS/Comet/TRUMPF envelope: 13-60 MHz, 0.6-6 kW, pulsing to 100 kHz - L01-049/050, L01-040) at premium prices with slow support, while frontier multi-frequency matching remains research-grade (L01-012); PCB and coating tenders show steady mid-market demand (L01-114, L01-039) that neither the duopoly's premium lines nor bare-bones local supplies serve with modern pulsing/arc-management.
product: A mid-power (1-30 kW) plasma power platform: pulsed-DC and RF variants with integrated fast matching, arc detection/quench (sub-microsecond energy diversion), recipe-level digital control, and fleet telemetry - positioned between imported premium units and commodity domestic supplies for coating, cleaning, and treatment tools.
frontier_vision: The power-and-control brain of industrial plasma processing across Asia, later feeding chemistry-grade waveform control into plasma nitriding, ozone, and materials synthesis.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-2027: prototype pulsed-DC 5 kW unit with arc-quench bench validated on a lab magnetron/PECVD target; benchmark vs published incumbent specs (L01-049/050). 2027-2028: RF variant + matching module; reliability run; patents on arc-energy diversion topology. 2028-2029: field beta on one Chinese PCB/coating line via equipment-maker collaboration (HK entity); cost-down BOM for China manufacturing license.
launch_2030_timing_thesis: Mid-market industrial plasma power is not commoditized in China (imports persist per incumbent map) yet not export-controlled like advanced-node RF - a 2030 entrant can win on service + pulsing features while avoiding the semi-etch battleground; risk of Hengyunchang-class players moving down-market is the main clock.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Named: Chinese PCB/advanced-packaging equipment upgrade cycle evidenced by recurring MOFCOM plasma-equipment tenders (L01-114, L01-039) and the AI-server PCB demand wave documented at Han's Laser (PCB equipment +50% in 2025, L12-037) - plasma cleaning scales with HDI/substrate volume through 2030-2034.
competition_outlook_2030: AE/MKS/Comet/TRUMPF premium imports (L01-040/049/050); Hengyunchang/Injet expanding from semi into industrial (L06-042/044); local low-end suppliers. Must win the middle on features-per-yuan and uptime service.
timing_window_risk: Domestic-substitution speed high; margin thin if it becomes a price fight - differentiate via arc management and telemetry or exit. Access: sell to OEMs/toolmakers, not end fabs; moderate.
commercial_readiness_kill_date: 2033-12-31: kill if no OEM design-win by end-2033 or if domestic mid-market pricing collapses below viable margin.
extreme_edge: Arc-quench and waveform IP feed forward into plasma-chemistry reactors (N2/CO2) if that field industrializes.
first_experiment: 2027-Q1: pulsed-DC 5 kW supply demonstrates arc detection + energy diversion in <1 microsecond on a deliberately arcing magnetron target, with zero target damage over 10,000 induced arcs; matching module holds reflected power <2% across a 3:1 load swing.

concept: Deterministic facility timing and fast machine-interlock platform (White Rabbit / IEEE 1588 class) productized for Chinese big-science facilities and industrial accelerators
named_buyer_examples: IHEP facilities (procurement style evidenced by HEPS China-manufacturer-only tenders, L07-045)
ASIPP - ITER magnet-feeder supplier and CFETR-era integrator (L13-035)
industrial accelerator integrators needing synchronized pulsed systems (CGN Dasheng-class, L05-035)
painful_job: Big-science I&C integration is a documented structural burden (ITER's split in-fund/in-kind procurement across ~161 plant systems, L13-030), and sub-ns facility timing (White Rabbit extending IEEE 1588-2019, L13-026/027) only became an open multi-vendor ecosystem in 2024 - Chinese facilities scaling through the 2030s must integrate timing + machine-protection from research-grade components with no productized, supported domestic-compatible platform.
product: A hardened timing-and-interlock product line: White-Rabbit-grade switches/nodes (sub-ns sync), deterministic fast-interlock I/O crates (microsecond machine-protection logic), and configuration/monitoring software - delivered with long-term support contracts and China-compatible licensing (open-hardware lineage eases localization).
frontier_vision: The nervous system of every large machine - accelerators, fusion plants, gravitational observatories, and eventually distributed industrial beam/pulsed-power fleets.
precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-2027: build on open White Rabbit designs; contribute upstream (visibility); benchtop sync demo at <100 ps skew across 10 nodes. 2027-2028: fast-interlock crate prototype with formal-verified logic; publish reliability analysis; engage one Asian facility control group for requirements. 2028-2029: pilot deployment at a university accelerator/test stand; define China licensing/manufacture structure (open-hardware model permits domestic fabrication with our support layer).
launch_2030_timing_thesis: White Rabbit's multi-vendor commercialization window opened 2024 (L13-027); Chinese facility pipeline (post-HEPS, CFETR-era) ramps in the 15th/16th FYP; support-and-integration layers resist commoditization even when hardware is open.
demand_trigger_2030_2034: Named: CFETR/BEST-era fusion facility I&C procurement (ASIPP integrator role documented via ITER feeders, L13-035; construction decision undated - flagged, L03-024) and next-round CAS light-source/collider control systems (procurement style per L07-045); industrial-accelerator synchronization demand grows with CGN Dasheng-class fleets (L05-035).
competition_outlook_2030: European White Rabbit vendors; Chinese institute in-house control groups (strong: publishing at ISSCC/VLSI level, L13-022/023); the export-control environment (US 2024 quantum rule, L13-031) pushes Chinese buyers toward non-US suppliers - a structural opening for a non-US-domiciled vendor, and a compliance wall for a US-person founder (must scope strictly to non-quantum, non-controlled facility timing; counsel required).
timing_window_risk: China-only procurement rules likely (L07-045) - license/JV route; export-control scoping is the gating uncertainty; institute in-house culture may self-supply. Confidence low-medium.
commercial_readiness_kill_date: 2033-12-31: kill if export-control scoping fails or no facility pilot by end-2033.
extreme_edge: Deterministic microsecond interlocks generalize to fusion-plant plasma-protection and grid-scale power-electronics coordination.

concept: 225-300C downhole electronics module: SOI/SiC hybrid controller, sensor interface and power stage with optional active cooling, filling the CISSOID-obsolescence gap for Chinese deep-well and geothermal drilling

product: A qualified downhole electronics module: 225C-rated SOI controller + SiC power stage + precision sensor front-end in a single hermetic chassis, with a plug-in sorption/evaporative active-cooling cartridge extending missions in 250-300C zones (mechanism: hybrid strategy bridging the documented native-HT vs active-cooling split, L15-023/024), delivered with full qualification data packs.
frontier_vision: The Honeywell-successor platform for hot electronics: downhole, geothermal, aero-engine, then 500C SiC-native modules as NASA-class IC processes mature.
